prompt.generated_prompt_string: Generate a hyperrealistic realistic-anime cinematic close-up of an adult woman against a completely black background. Use a narrow hard spotlight focused only on the center of her face, with sharp dramatic edges and high-falloff shadow so everything outside the spot rapidly blends into black. She has long dark hair with strands falling over her face; the lower hair and black long-sleeve knit sweater fade into the darkness. One hand is raised gently near her lips in a shy, hesitant gesture, while she looks directly at camera with a mysterious mood. Keep high contrast only in the lit face area. 85mm close-up, f/2, natural skin texture, subtle grain.
